description: This file is a PHP template for rendering the admin interface for managing channel posts. It includes HTML, embedded PHP, JavaScript, and calls to template functions, handling filtering, adding, and listing posts within the admin panel.

methods.name: goChannelposts
methods.description: Navigates to a specific channel post filter/page based on selected node.

methods.name: toggle_typeahead
methods.description: Shows or hides the typeahead post input section.

methods.name: send_post
methods.description: Sends a new post via AJAX to the server and reloads the page upon success.
